## Everest Technologies, Inc - Senior Software Engineer – PIM

🔗 [Apply](https://etech.zohorecruit.com/jobs/careers/661503000015854001/Senior-Sofware-Engineer---PIM?source=CareerSite)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer designing event-driven microservices and integrations for Akeneo PIM. Modernizing product catalog systems powering global retail commerce.
Senior Software Engineer modernizing Akeneo PIM systems for global retail commerce
- Tech stack: Apache, AWS, Azure, Cloud, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, Gradle, Grafana, Java, JavaScript, Kafka, Kubernetes, Microservices, MongoDB, MySQL, Node.js, NoSQL, Oracle
- Support and evolve the Akeneo PIM SaaS/Enterprise platform as the live system of record
- Maintain modern cloud-native architectures replacing legacy workflows and batch jobs
- Design, develop, and maintain resilient microservices and stream-processing pipelines using Apache Kafka, schema registries, and modern backend frameworks
- Implement scalable product hierarchy models, variant structures, reference entities, category mappings, and delta-calculation engines
- Build high-reliability connectors and APIs integrating PIM with upstream and downstream systems
- Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain the live Akeneo PIM platform for 24/7 availability and minimal downtime
- Optimize API response times, database query performance, and payload processing
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to design and deploy incremental features, custom attributes, and localized catalog workflows
- Strong proficiency in building robust, secure microservices and API architectures (RESTful, SOAP) using Java, Spring frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud), Node.js / TypeScript, Go, or Python
- Deep hands-on experience with distributed streaming platforms and message-oriented middleware
- Expert knowledge of the publisher/subscriber model, including Apache Kafka (topic architecture, consumer groups, partition strategies, schema registry, event headers), RabbitMQ, and IBM MQ
- Solid experience designing and optimizing relational, NoSQL, and memory-cached databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, CloudSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
- Expert in query optimization tailored for high-volume catalog, SKU, and enterprise datasets
- Practical experience deploying, managing, and orchestrating workloads in agile, cloud-native environments across GCP, AWS, or Azure
- Proficient with Kubernetes (GKE), Docker, and enterprise CI/CD automation tools (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Bamboo)
- Strong foundational understanding of modern security concepts, including authentication protocols, Single Sign-On (SSO), and secure data transmission

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer designing event-driven microservices and integrations for Akeneo PIM. Modernizing product catalog systems powering global retail commerce.
Senior Software Engineer modernizing Akeneo PIM systems for global retail commerce
Role description:
• Support and evolve the Akeneo PIM SaaS/Enterprise platform as the live system of record
• Maintain modern cloud-native architectures replacing legacy workflows and batch jobs
• Design, develop, and maintain resilient microservices and stream-processing pipelines using Apache Kafka, schema registries, and modern backend frameworks
• Implement scalable product hierarchy models, variant structures, reference entities, category mappings, and delta-calculation engines
• Build high-reliability connectors and APIs integrating PIM with upstream and downstream systems
• Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain the live Akeneo PIM platform for 24/7 availability and minimal downtime
• Optimize API response times, database query performance, and payload processing
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to design and deploy incremental features, custom attributes, and localized catalog workflows
• Plan, test, and execute platform upgrades and patches while maintaining data accuracy
• Translate complex business requirements into robust backend systems and databases
• Deliver frequent, high-impact releases under Agile principles
Role requirements:
• Strong proficiency in building robust, secure microservices and API architectures (RESTful, SOAP) using Java, Spring frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud), Node.js / TypeScript, Go, or Python
• Deep hands-on experience with distributed streaming platforms and message-oriented middleware
• Expert knowledge of the publisher/subscriber model, including Apache Kafka (topic architecture, consumer groups, partition strategies, schema registry, event headers), RabbitMQ, and IBM MQ
• Solid experience designing and optimizing relational, NoSQL, and memory-cached databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, CloudSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
• Expert in query optimization tailored for high-volume catalog, SKU, and enterprise datasets
• Practical experience deploying, managing, and orchestrating workloads in agile, cloud-native environments across GCP, AWS, or Azure
• Proficient with Kubernetes (GKE), Docker, and enterprise CI/CD automation tools (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Bamboo)
• Strong foundational understanding of modern security concepts, including authentication protocols, Single Sign-On (SSO), and secure data transmission
• Experience working with enterprise Product Information Management (PIM) and catalog management solutions such as Akeneo
• Background in data migration strategies (delta loads, reconciliation scripts, and dual-entry cutover planning)
• Knowledge in API security Gateway Frameworks/concepts
• Experience in application servers such as WebLogic, Tomcat, etc.
• Working knowledge of Gradle
• Working knowledge of Grafana / Splunk
Tech stack:
Apache, AWS, Azure, Cloud, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, Gradle, Grafana, Java, JavaScript, Kafka, Kubernetes, Microservices, MongoDB, MySQL, Node.js, NoSQL, Oracle, Postgres, Python, RabbitMQ, Redis, SOAP, Splunk, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot, TypeScript, Go
